text: There is no action save upon a balance of considerations.”—_Paraphrase_.
zh: 除非权衡考虑，否则不会采取任何行动。”——_释义_。
chunks: There is no action save
upon a balance
of considerations.”— _Paraphrase_.

text: The fact is that “Erewhon” was finished, with the exception of the last twenty pages and a sentence or two inserted from time to time here and there throughout the book, before the first advertisement of “The Coming Race” appeared.
zh: 事实上，在《即将到来的种族》的第一个广告出现之前，《Erewhon》已经完成，除了最后二十页和全书中不时插入的一两句话。
chunks: The fact is that “Erewhon” was finished,
with the exception of the last twenty pages
and a sentence or two inserted from time
to time here and there throughout the book,
before the first advertisement of “The Coming Race” appeared.

text: Then I had much pleasure in reading it, but was indeed surprised at the many little points of similarity between the two books, in spite of their entire independence to one another.
zh: 然后我很高兴地阅读了这本书，但确实对这两本书之间的许多小相似点感到惊讶，尽管它们完全相互独立。
chunks: Then I had much pleasure
in reading it, but was indeed surprised
at the many little points
of similarity between the two books,
in spite of their entire independence to one another.

text: The only question in my mind was how far I could afford to be misrepresented as laughing at that for which I have the most profound admiration.
zh: 我心中唯一的问题是，我在多大程度上可以承受被误解为嘲笑我最钦佩的事物。
chunks: The only question in my mind was
how far I could afford
to be misrepresented
as laughing at that
for which I have the most profound admiration.

text: An anonymous correspondent (by the hand-writing presumably a clergyman) tells me that in quoting from the Latin grammar I should at any rate have done so correctly, and that I should have written “agricolas” instead of “agricolae”.
zh: 一位匿名通讯员（笔迹大概是牧师）告诉我，在引用拉丁文语法时，我无论如何都应该正确地这样做，而且我应该写“agricolas”而不是“agricolae”。
chunks: An anonymous correspondent
(by the hand-writing presumably a clergyman) tells me
that in quoting from the Latin grammar I should
at any rate have done so correctly,
and that I should have written “agricolas” instead of “agricolae”.

text: The blame, however, lies chiefly with the Erewhonians themselves, for they were really a very difficult people to understand.
zh: 然而，这主要归咎于埃雷洪尼亚人本身，因为他们确实是一个很难理解的民族。
chunks: The blame, however,
lies chiefly
with the Erewhonians themselves,
for they were really a very difficult people
to understand.

text: My publisher wishes me to say a few words about the genesis of the work, a revised and enlarged edition of which he is herewith laying before the public.
zh: 我的出版商希望我就这部作品的起源说几句话，他现将其修订和扩大的版本摆在公众面前。
chunks: My publisher wishes me
to say a few words about the genesis
of the work, a revised and enlarged edition
of which he is herewith laying
before the public.

text: Erewhon” were also drawn from the Upper Rangitata district, with such modifications as I found convenient.
zh: Erewhon”也来自上朗吉塔塔地区，并进行了我认为方便的修改。
chunks: Erewhon” were also drawn
from the Upper Rangitata district,
with such modifications
as I found convenient.

text: It appeared July 1, 1865, under the heading, “The Mechanical Creation,” and can be seen in the British Museum.
zh: 它于 1865 年 7 月 1 日出版，标题为“机械创造”，现藏于大英博物馆。
chunks: It appeared July 1, 1865,
under the heading,
“The Mechanical Creation,
” and can be seen
in the British Museum.

text: (then Mr.) Broome, suggested to me that I should add somewhat to the articles I had already written, and string them together into a book.
zh: （当时的）布鲁姆先生向我建议，我应该在已经写的文章中添加一些内容，并将它们整理成一本书。
chunks: (then Mr.) Broome, suggested to me
that I should add somewhat
to the articles I had already written,
and string them together
into a book.

text: As regards its rejection by Messrs.
zh: 至于遭到先生的拒绝。
chunks: As regards its rejection
by Messrs.

text: Erewhon” appeared with the last day or two of March 1872.
zh: “Erewhon”出现在 1872 年 3 月的最后一两天。
chunks: Erewhon” appeared
with the last day or two of March 1872.

text: The first edition of “Erewhon” sold in about three weeks; I had not taken moulds, and as the demand was strong, it was set up again immediately.
zh: 《Erewhon》第一版在大约三周内售出；我没有拿模具，由于需求旺盛，所以立即重新搭建。
chunks: The first edition of “Erewhon” sold
in about three weeks;
I had not taken moulds,
and as the demand was strong,
it was set up again immediately.

text: I am still fairly well satisfied with those parts of “Erewhon” that were repeatedly rewritten, but from those that had only a single writing I would gladly cut out some forty or fifty pages if I could.
zh: 我对《Erewhon》中那些被反复重写的部分仍然相当满意，但如果可以的话，我很乐意从那些只有单一文字的部分中删掉四十或五十页。
chunks: I am still fairly well satisfied
with those parts of “Erewhon”
that were repeatedly rewritten, but from those
that had only a single writing I would gladly cut
out some forty or fifty pages if I could.

text: November 1900 and the end of April 1901.
chunks: November 1900
and the end of April 1901.

text: Nevertheless, though in literary workmanship I do not doubt that this last-named book is an improvement on the first, I shall be agreeably surprised if I am not told that “Erewhon,” with all its faults, is the better reading of the two.
zh: 尽管如此，尽管在文学创作上，我并不怀疑这最后一本书比第一本书有所进步，但如果我没有被告知《埃里翁》尽管有种种缺点，却是两本书中更好的读物，我会感到惊讶。
chunks: Nevertheless, though in literary workmanship I do not doubt
that this last-named book is an improvement
on the first, I shall be agreeably surprised
if I am not told that “Erewhon, ” with all its faults,
is the better reading of the two.

text: But to this end I must possess myself of a considerable sum of money: neither do I know how to get it, except by interesting the public in my story, and inducing the charitable to come forward and assist me.
zh: 但为了这个目的，我必须拥有一大笔钱：我也不知道如何得到它，除非让公众对我的故事感兴趣，并诱导慈善机构出面帮助我。
chunks: But to this end I must possess myself
of a considerable sum of money:
neither do I know how to get it,
except by interesting the public in my story, and inducing the charitable
to come forward and assist me.

text: No one who is himself honest will doubt my being so.
zh: 任何一个诚实的人都不会怀疑我的诚实。
chunks: No one
who is himself honest will doubt my being so.

text: With this bay of land, however, the case was different.
zh: 然而，对于这片土地来说，情况就不同了。
chunks: With this bay
of land, however,
the case was different.

text: Men pushed farther and farther into the mountains, and found a very considerable tract inside the front range, between it and another which was loftier still, though even this was not the highest, the great snowy one which could be seen from out upon the plains.
chunks: Men pushed farther and farther into the mountains,
and found a very considerable tract
inside the front range, between it and another
which was loftier still, though even this was not the highest,
the great snowy one which could be seen from out upon the plains.

text: I was to see the sheep, not necessarily close at hand, nor to get them in a single mob, but to see enough of them here and there to feel easy that nothing had gone wrong; this was no difficult matter, for there were not above eight hundred of them; and, being all breeding ewes, they were pretty quiet.
chunks: I was to see the sheep, not necessarily close at hand,
nor to get them in a single mob, but to see enough
of them here and there to feel easy that nothing had gone wrong;
this was no difficult matter, for there were not
above eight hundred of them; and, being all breeding ewes, they were pretty quiet.

text: I had a telescope and a dog, and would take bread and meat and tobacco with me.
zh: 我有一架望远镜和一只狗，还会随身携带面包、肉和烟草。
chunks: I had a telescope
and a dog,
and would take bread
and meat and tobacco
with me.

text: The country was the grandest that can be imagined.
zh: 这个国家是可以想象的最宏伟的国家。
chunks: The country was the grandest
that can be imagined.

text: Then there comes some lean and withered old ewe, with deep gruff voice and unlovely aspect, trotting back from the seductive pasture; now she examines this gully, and now that, and now she stands listening with uplifted head, that she may hear the distant wailing and obey it.
chunks: Then there comes some lean and withered old ewe, with deep gruff voice
and unlovely aspect, trotting back from the seductive pasture;
now she examines this gully, and now that,
and now she stands listening with uplifted head,
that she may hear the distant wailing and obey it.

text: I could not help speculating upon what might lie farther up the river and behind the second range.
zh: 我忍不住猜测河流上游和第二个山脉后面可能有什么。
chunks: I could not help speculating
upon what might lie farther up the river and behind the second range.

text: I would try the nearer range, and see how far I could go.
zh: 我会尝试更近的范围，看看我能走多远。
chunks: I would try the nearer range,
and see
how far I could go.

text: These thoughts filled my head, and I could not banish them.
zh: 这些想法充斥着我的脑海，我无法驱逐它们。
chunks: These thoughts filled my head,
and I could not banish them.

text: But when I came to the main range, his manner changed at once.
zh: 但当我来到主靶场时，他的态度立刻就变了。
chunks: But when I came
to the main range,
his manner changed
at once.

text: I gave him any, or get none at all.
zh: 我给了他任何东西，或者根本没有得到。
chunks: I gave him any,
or get none
at all.

text: It always refreshed me with a semblance of antiquity (precious in a new country), though I very well knew that the oldest wool-shed in the settlement was not more than seven years old, while this was only two.
zh: 它总是让我感到一种古老的感觉（在一个新的国家很珍贵），尽管我很清楚，定居点里最古老的羊毛棚不超过七年，而这只有两年。
chunks: It always refreshed me with a semblance of antiquity (precious
in a new country), though I very well knew
that the oldest wool-shed
in the settlement was not more
than seven years old, while this was only two.

text: At the best of times Chowbok was very ugly, but he now exceeded all conceivable limits of the hideous.
zh: 乔博克在最好的时候是非常丑陋的，但现在他已经超出了所有可以想象的丑陋极限。
chunks: At the best
of times Chowbok was very ugly,
but he now exceeded all conceivable limits
of the hideous.

text: For myself I was open-mouthed with astonishment.
zh: 就我自己而言，我惊讶得张大了嘴巴。
chunks: For myself I was open-mouthed
with astonishment.

text: Of his meaning I had no conception.
zh: 我对他的意思一无所知。
chunks: Of his meaning I
had no conception.

text: I knew not what the great snowy ranges might conceal, but I could no longer doubt that it would be something well worth discovering.
zh: 我不知道这片大雪山里可能隐藏着什么，但我不再怀疑这将是非常值得发现的东西。
chunks: I knew not what the great snowy ranges might conceal,
but I could no longer doubt
that it would be something well worth discovering.

text: I said nothing about the main range, for I knew it would frighten him.
zh: 我没有提及主要范围，因为我知道这会吓到他。
chunks: I said nothing
about the main range,
for I knew it would frighten him.

text: My master let me have tea and sugar, ship’s biscuits, tobacco, and salt mutton, with two or three bottles of good brandy; for, as the wool was now sent down, abundance of provisions would come up with the empty drays.
zh: 主人让我吃茶、糖、船上饼干、烟草、盐羊肉，还有两三瓶上好的白兰地；因为，当羊毛被运下来时，大量的粮食就会用空车运来。
chunks: My master let me have tea
and sugar, ship’s biscuits, tobacco, and salt mutton, with two
or three bottles of good brandy; for,
as the wool was now sent down,
abundance of provisions would come up with the empty drays.

text: The weather was delightfully warm, considering that the valley in which we were encamped must have been at least two thousand feet above the level of the sea.
zh: 考虑到我们扎营的山谷至少海拔两千英尺，天气温暖得令人愉快。
chunks: The weather was delightfully warm,
considering that the valley
in which we were encamped must have been
at least two thousand feet
above the level of the sea.

text: Behind us rose the lowest spurs of the second range, leading abruptly to the range itself; and at a distance of half a mile began the gorge, where the river narrowed and became boisterous and terrible.
zh: 我们身后升起第二个山脉的最低支线，突然通向山脉本身。距离半英里处，峡谷开始了，河水变窄，变得汹涌而可怕。
chunks: Behind us rose the lowest spurs
of the second range, leading abruptly
to the range itself; and at a distance
of half a mile began the gorge,
where the river narrowed and became boisterous and terrible.

text: We set about making our camp, close to some large bush which came down from the mountains on to the flat, and tethered out our horses upon ground as free as we could find it from anything round which they might wind the rope and get themselves tied up.
chunks: We set about making our camp, close to some large bush
which came down from the mountains
on to the flat, and tethered out our horses
upon ground as free as we could find it from anything round
which they might wind the rope and get themselves tied up.

text: Chowbok plucked them a little and singed them a good deal.
chunks: Chowbok plucked them a little
and singed them a good deal.

text: I call it to mind and delight in it now, but I did not notice it at the time.
zh: 我现在想起它并乐在其中，但当时我没有注意到。
chunks: I call it
to mind and delight
in it now,
but I did not notice it
at the time.

text: We found as soft a piece of ground as we could—though it was all stony—and having collected grass and so disposed of ourselves that we had a little hollow for our hip-bones, we strapped our blankets around us and went to sleep.
zh: 我们找到了一块尽可能松软的土地——尽管全是石头——然后收集了草，把自己处理掉，让我们的髋骨有了一点空洞，我们把毯子绑在身上，然后就睡觉了。
chunks: We found as soft a piece of ground as we could—
though it was all stony— and having collected grass
and so disposed of ourselves that we had a little hollow
for our hip-bones, we strapped our blankets
around us and went to sleep.

text: We were two hours in making less than a mile, and that with danger, sometimes in the river and sometimes on the rock.
zh: 我们花了两个小时才走了不到一英里，而且充满危险，有时在河里，有时在岩石上。
chunks: We were two hours
in making less than a mile,
and that with danger,
sometimes in the river
and sometimes on the rock.

text: I suppose this lasted three miles, but it was well midday when the gorge got a little wider, and a small stream came into it from a tributary valley.
zh: 我想这持续了三英里，但已经是中午了，峡谷变得更宽了，一条小溪从支流山谷流入了峡谷。
chunks: I suppose this lasted three miles,
but it was well midday
when the gorge got a little wider,
and a small stream came
into it from a tributary valley.

text: On the saddle there was some coarse grass which was in full seed, and therefore very nourishing for the horses; also abundance of anise and sow-thistle, of which they are extravagantly fond, so we turned them loose and prepared to camp.
zh: 马鞍上有一些粗草，种子饱满，对马来说非常有营养。还有大量的茴香和母猪蓟，它们非常喜欢，所以我们把它们放了出来，准备扎营。
chunks: On the saddle there was some coarse grass
which was in full seed, and therefore very nourishing for the horses;
also abundance of anise and sow-thistle,
of which they are extravagantly fond,
so we turned them loose and prepared to camp.

text: But we could see the main range.
zh: 但我们可以看到主要范围。
chunks: But we could see
the main range.

text: His dislike of the main range appeared to have worn off, and he made no objections to approaching it.
zh: 他对主山脉的厌恶似乎已经消失，并且他并不反对接近它。
chunks: His dislike
of the main range appeared
to have worn off,
and he made no objections
to approaching it.

text: The weather was fine, though the nights got very cold.
zh: 天气很好，虽然夜晚很冷。
chunks: The weather was fine,
though the nights got very cold.

text: My blood was all on fire with hope and elation; but on looking round for Chowbok, who was behind me, I saw to my surprise and anger that he had turned back, and was going down the valley as hard as he could.
zh: 我的血液因希望和兴高采烈而燃烧；但当我环顾四周寻找我身后的乔博克时，我惊讶又愤怒地发现他已经转身，正竭尽全力地走下山谷。
chunks: My blood was all on fire with hope and elation;
but on looking round for Chowbok, who was
behind me, I saw to my surprise and anger
that he had turned back, and was going down the valley
as hard as he could.

text: Then I sat down on a stone and thought the matter carefully over.
zh: 然后我坐在一块石头上，仔细地想了想。
chunks: Then I sat down
on a stone and thought the matter carefully over.

text: Hardly; yet to proceed alone would be both difficult and dangerous.
zh: 几乎没有；但单独前进既困难又危险。
chunks: Hardly;
yet to proceed alone would be both difficult
and dangerous.

text: After much thought, I resolved to go forward until I should come to some place which was really dangerous, but then to return.
zh: 想了想，我决定继续往前走，直到到达真正危险的地方，然后再返回。
chunks: After much thought, I resolved
to go forward until I should come
to some place
which was really dangerous,
but then to return.

text: Chowbok had carried half, but had dropped his whole swag—I suppose, at the moment of his taking flight—for I came upon it when I ran after him.
zh: 乔博克带着一半，但把他的全部赃物都扔掉了——我想是在他起飞的那一刻——因为我在追赶他时发现了它。
chunks: Chowbok had carried half,
but had dropped his whole swag—
I suppose, at the moment of his taking flight—
for I came upon it
when I ran after him.

text: Then I tied the two ends together, and put the whole round my neck and over one shoulder.
zh: 然后我把两端绑在一起，把整个挂在脖子上和肩膀上。
chunks: Then I tied the two ends together,
and put the whole round my neck
and over one shoulder.

text: Ten minutes more, and the cold air from the other side came rushing upon me.
zh: 又过了十分钟，对岸的冷空气迎面扑来。
chunks: Ten minutes more,
and the cold air
from the other side came rushing
upon me.

text: Another glance, and then I remained motionless.
zh: 我又看了一眼，然后就一动不动了。
chunks: Another glance,
and then I remained motionless.

text: Had I arrived five minutes later, the cloud would have been over the pass, and I should not have known of its existence.
zh: 如果我晚五分钟到达，云就会在山口上空，我就不应该知道它的存在。
chunks: Had I arrived five minutes later,
the cloud would have been
over the pass,
and I should not have known
of its existence.

text: The night would be upon me shortly, and I was already chilled with standing still after the exertion of climbing.
zh: 夜色即将降临，爬完高山后，我已经站着不动了，浑身发冷。
chunks: The night would be
upon me shortly,
and I was already chilled
with standing still after the exertion
of climbing.

text: It was impossible to say what precipices might prevent my doing so.
zh: 很难说有什么困难会阻止我这样做。
chunks: It was impossible
to say what precipices might prevent my doing so.

text: The more I thought, the more determined I became either to win fame and perhaps fortune, by entering upon this unknown world, or give up life in the attempt.
zh: 我想得越多，我就越坚定，要么通过进入这个未知的世界来赢得名誉，或许还有财富，要么放弃生命。
chunks: The more I thought,
the more determined I became either
to win fame and perhaps fortune, by entering
upon this unknown world,
or give up life in the attempt.

text: I was on the brink of a frightful precipice, which no one in his senses would attempt descending.
zh: 我正处于一个可怕的悬崖边缘，任何有理智的人都不会尝试掉下去。
chunks: I was
on the brink
of a frightful precipice,
which no one
in his senses would attempt descending.

text: I dared not think of getting down at all, unless I committed myself to the rift, of which I was hopeful when I reflected that the rock was soft, and that the water might have worn its channel tolerably evenly through the whole extent.
zh: 我根本不敢想下去，除非我把自己投入到裂缝中，当我想到岩石是软的，而且水可能在整个范围内相当均匀地磨损它的通道时，我对此充满希望。
chunks: I dared not think of getting down at all,
unless I committed myself to the rift,
of which I was hopeful when I reflected that the rock was soft,
and that the water might have worn its channel tolerably evenly
through the whole extent.

text: I was wet through from falling into the water, of which there was no great volume, but it had such force that I could do nothing against it; once I had to leap down a not inconsiderable waterfall into a deep pool below, and my swag was so heavy that I was very nearly drowned.
chunks: I was wet through from falling into the water,
of which there was no great volume, but it had such force
that I could do nothing against it; once I had to leap down a not inconsiderable waterfall
into a deep pool below, and my swag was so heavy
that I was very nearly drowned.

text: My first care was for my matches; were they dry?
zh: 我首先关心的是我的比赛；它们干吗？
chunks: My first care was
for my matches;
were they dry?

text: I made myself some tea and ate two of my biscuits: my brandy I did not touch, for I had little left, and might want it when my courage failed me.
chunks: I made myself some tea
and ate two of my biscuits:
my brandy I did not touch,
for I had little left, and might want it
when my courage failed me.

text: I took off my clothes, and wrapped my inside blanket about me, till my things were dry.
chunks: I took
off my clothes,
and wrapped my
inside blanket about me,
till my things were dry.

text: Then there was one who touched me on the shoulder, and said, “Do you not see? it is Handel”;—but I had hardly apprehended, and was trying to scale the terraces, and get near him, when I awoke, dazzled with the vividness and distinctness of the dream.
chunks: Then there was one who touched me on the shoulder, and said,
“Do you not see? it is Handel”; — but I had hardly apprehended,
and was trying to scale the terraces,
and get near him, when I awoke,
dazzled with the vividness and distinctness of the dream.

text: I held my breath and waited, and then I heard—was it fancy?
chunks: I held my breath
and waited,
and then I heard—
was it fancy?

text: Yes; it was that.
chunks: Yes;
it was that.

text: I said my prayers, a duty which I had too often neglected, and in a little time fell into a really refreshing sleep, which lasted till broad daylight, and restored me.
chunks: I said my prayers, a duty
which I had too often neglected,
and in a little time fell
into a really refreshing sleep,
which lasted till broad daylight, and restored me.

text: Exploring is delightful to look forward to and back upon, but it is not comfortable at the time, unless it be of such an easy nature as not to deserve the name.
chunks: Exploring is delightful to look forward
to and back upon, but it is not comfortable
at the time, unless it be
of such an easy nature
as not to deserve the name.

text: In a couple of hours I got among pine forests where there was little undergrowth, and descended quickly till I reached the edge of another precipice, which gave me a great deal of trouble, though I eventually managed to avoid it.
chunks: In a couple of hours I got
among pine forests where there was little undergrowth,
and descended quickly till I reached the edge
